definitions.explanation: A minimal, natural-looking application of cosmetics, as opposed to heavy or dramatic makeup.

examples.japanese: {薄化粧|うすげしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: To go out with light makeup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄化粧|うすげしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧。

⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄化粧|うすげしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{清潔感|せいけつかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけた→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: For the interview, I aimed for a clean impression with light makeup.

notes:
Compound noun: {薄|うす} (thin, light) + ⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧ (makeup, cosmetics). The opposite is {厚化粧|あつげしょう} (heavy makeup).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄化粧|うすげしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧ (to go out with light makeup)
- {薄化粧|うすげしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧ (light makeup suits someone)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese business and social settings, {薄化粧|うすげしょう} is generally considered appropriate and professional, while heavy makeup may be seen as unsuitable for formal contexts.
